svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print open side up, 0.2 mm layers, 6 perimeters (2.5 mm walls), 40 % infill.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Outside 160 x 62 x 16 mm, 10 mm corner radius; floor and walls 2.5 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tongue 1.2 x 2.6 mm stands up inside the rim; it locates the top shell.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Window hole 25.4 mm on the scan axis, 55 mm ahead of the centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Three 3.4 mm holes round it on a 40 mm circle for the shroud screws.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four shell bosses 7 mm at 68 mm each side of centre, 20 mm out:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3.4 mm through, 6.2 mm counterbore 3.2 mm deep from below.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cell cradle: two 1.5 mm rails and two 3 mm end walls 75 mm apart.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two strap bosses beside the cradle take M3 inserts (4 mm hole).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tail wall: USB-C opening 9.5 x 3.8 mm, 8 mm up; seat inside for the board.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Right wall: switch slot 7 x 3.5 mm and two 2.4 mm holes 15 mm apart.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the top shell drops over the tongue without force.
